title: Red Light, Green Light
description: Pick a muppet-style video caller who says the cues in their own voice for a whole-body stop-and-go listening game.
learningGoals: Practice impulse control through stop/go movement
Switch actions in response to spoken cues
Build playful self-regulation with family participation
interactionModel: the child picks a video-puppet caller; the caller bops and calls Green Light to run, then freezes on Red Light — children move, freeze, or wiggle in the room
feedbackModel: each caller's own recorded voice plus a bold red/green frame color cue and pop/boing/silly/tada SFX; no failure state, just repeated movement cues and celebration
credits: Kaigani. Original video-puppet callers (art, voice, and talking video) generated locally with LTX-2.3 + Qwen TTS; see ASSETS.md. Built for QLOBE Kids.
